title: Supplementary cryptography approval needs exact deployment configuration evidence
remediation: The sponsor cryptographic authority and deployment security engineer verify the contract-selected cryptography and effective settings for each assessed protection use. Retain approved type, module and version references, permitted mode where relevant and a redacted comparison to deployment observations. Leave nonmatching or unresolved scope pending authorized disposition.

milestones.title: Collect approved cryptographic requirements, versioned implementation evidence, and a dated conformance comparison with any open discrepancy
